mapper.select: SELECT so.id, so.code, so.approve_status, so.order_type, so.warehouse_org_id, so.warehouse_org_name, so.warehouse_id, so.warehouse_name, so.plan_delivery_date, so.pack_date, so.actual_delivery_date, so.create_time, so.create_user_name, so.customer_id, sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, sod.plan_qty, sod.actual_qty FROM so_outstock so INNER JOIN so_outstock_detail sod ON sod.main_id=so.id AND sod.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE so.is_deleted=FALSE AND so.so_id=#{soId} ORDER BY so.create_time DESC
SELECT so.id FROM "temp_recovry_record" trr,${tableName} so where trr.code = so.code and so.is_deleted = false and so.approve_status = 'approve' limit 1000

SELECT sum(sod.actual_qty) as actualTotalQty, sum(sod.plan_qty) as planTotalQty, sum(sod.all_amount_local_currency) as totalTaxAmount FROM so_outstock so INNER JOIN so_outstock_detail sod ON so.id = sod.main_id AND sod.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and so.is_deleted = FALSE
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT so.id, sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, SUM(sod.actual_qty) AS deliveryQty from so_outstock_detail sod LEFT JOIN so_outstock so ON so.id = sod.main_id AND so.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE sod.is_deleted=FALSE AND sod.main_id = #{mainId} GROUP BY so.id, sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no

SELECT g.id,g.platform_code so_code,t.customer_name shop_name, T.warehouse_name, G.sku_no, G.platform_detail_id platform_sku_no, G.actual_qty::VARCHAR actual_qty, TO_CHAR(T.bill_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') bill_date FROM so_outstock T LEFT JOIN so_outstock_detail G ON T.ID = G.main_id
SELECT count(g.id) FROM so_outstock T LEFT JOIN so_outstock_detail G ON T.ID = G.main_id
